senses.definition_en: An estimation of how much something is worth.
senses.explanation_ar: تثمين أو تقدير مالي لقيمة شيء ما (مثل عقار أو شركة).
examples: The bank asked for a valuation of the house.
They disagreed with the official valuation of the property.
Market volatility makes accurate asset valuation extremely difficult.
